title: rpg-classic condition
description: The project's single condition vocabulary, shared by eve.rpgc.event (branch steps) and eve.rpgc.world (portal gates) through a whole-schema `ref`. A second copy of this enum in another schema file is how the two syntaxes would drift apart, so there is exactly one. `moment` is the only kind this workflow added on top of the engine-facing set; the rest (variable / switch / object_consumed / always) are the ones docs/03-event-editor.md documents.
